newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China hijack attempt foiled - Hong Kong paper.
newsitem.headline: China hijack attempt foiled - Hong Kong paper.

text.p: Crew and passengers on a Chinese domestic flight overpowered a man who tried to hijack the plane to Taiwan, a Hong Kong newspaper reported on Sunday.
The plane was en route from the southern city of Guangzhou to Xiamen on Friday when a passenger claiming he possessed explosives ordered the captain to fly to Taiwan, the Sing Pao daily said.
But crew and passengers overwhelmed the would-be hijacker and the plane landed safely at Xiamen in Fujian province, across the strait from Taiwan, it said, but gave no further details.
Chinese domestic carriers endured a rash of hijackings in 1993 and 1994 from passengers seeking asylum in Nationalist-ruled Taiwan.
But air piracy fell off sharply after Beijing launched a major drive to improve what had been lax security at most airports.
Only three hijackings have come to light since late 1994 and they were foiled by plainclothes security officials who now fly routinely on most Chinese domestic flights.
